snippet.title: Building Relationships - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience life as a house in this silly adventure game! Play as a building as you roll, jump, and wave-dash to explore a mysterious island. Meet eligible structures, romance them, and experience a bizarre, yet oddly familiar story... or go fishing instead (though we replaced fish with cars, because that made more sense).

Wishlist "Building Relationships" on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666920/Building_Relationships/
